## Research & Development Projects

This page highlights some of my key research projects, open-source contributions, and software tools in the areas of artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and digital twins.

---

### Digital Twin Framework for Industrial Systems

A comprehensive framework for building digital twins of manufacturing and industrial systems using reinforcement learning and simulation modeling.

**Key Features:**
- Real-time synchronization between physical and digital systems
- Predictive maintenance using ML models
- Optimization algorithms for resource allocation
- Scalable architecture for multi-agent systems

**Technologies:** Python, PyTorch, SimPy, Ray

**Status:** Active Research

---

### Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Scheduling

Research project focused on developing RL algorithms for dynamic job scheduling in complex manufacturing environments with stochastic demand.

**Highlights:**
- Custom gym-compatible environment for scheduling problems
- Comparison of DQN, PPO, and A3C algorithms
- Integration with discrete-event simulation
- Benchmark against traditional heuristics (FIFO, EDD, SPT)

**Technologies:** Python, Stable-Baselines3, NumPy, Pandas

**Publications:** In preparation

---

### Optimization Toolkit for Production Planning

An open-source Python library providing implementations of classical and modern optimization algorithms for production planning and supply chain management.

**Features:**
- Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) solvers
- Metaheuristic algorithms (GA, PSO, SA)
- Multi-objective optimization
- Visualization tools for solution analysis

**Technologies:** Python, PuLP, SciPy, Plotly

**GitHub:** Coming Soon

---

### Graph Neural Networks for Supply Chain Networks

Applying GNN architectures to model and optimize supply chain networks, with focus on demand forecasting and inventory optimization.

**Contributions:**
- Custom message-passing layers for supply chain graphs
- Attention mechanisms for multi-tier networks
- Temporal graph modeling for time-series forecasting
- Benchmarking against traditional forecasting methods

**Technologies:** PyTorch Geometric, NetworkX, scikit-learn

**Status:** Active Research

---

### Machine Learning Course Materials

Open-source teaching materials, Jupyter notebooks, and interactive tutorials for machine learning courses.

**Contents:**
- Foundational ML algorithms with Python implementations
- Deep learning with PyTorch tutorials
- Reinforcement learning from scratch
- Real-world case studies and datasets

**Technologies:** Python, Jupyter, scikit-learn, PyTorch

**GitHub:** Coming Soon

---

### Simulation Modeling Library

A Python library for discrete-event simulation with built-in support for common modeling patterns in manufacturing, healthcare, and service systems.

**Features:**
- Object-oriented simulation framework
- Statistical analysis tools
- Animation and visualization
- Integration with optimization algorithms

**Technologies:** Python, SimPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn

**Status:** In Development
